records.name: KuvMusic
records.tagline: Turn music ideas into beats, songs, and videos.
records.description: Kuv Music turns hums, Vocal mode ideas, lyrics, rhythm taps, and prompts into AI beats, song starters, full songs, MIDI exports, and music videos.

records.name: Trovelo
records.tagline: Plan and track your trips privately
records.description: Trovelo is a private trip planner for iPhone and Mac — no accounts, no servers, no subscription. Built by a solo traveler with 40+ countries of experience frustrated with every existing app. Plan day by day with smart cards, type naturally and the app figures it out, track expenses in dual currency, optimize your route, and sync privately via iCloud. One-time $6.99 Pro. Yours forever.

records.name: findloc.ai
records.tagline: Make your business citable by ChatGPT, Claude & Perplexity
records.description: When customers ask ChatGPT "best Airbnb in Rotorua", it names 3-5 specific properties. If you're not on that list, you're invisible — no matter your Google rank. findloc.ai probes ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini weekly across (city × industry) markets and publishes who gets cited — with verbatim AI answers. Free to view. Live data, refreshed every Sunday.

records.name: Galleroo
records.tagline: Turn your Google Drive into a stunning client gallery
records.description: Galleroo turns any Google Drive folder into a beautiful, password-protected client gallery in under 60 seconds. No re-uploading, no account needed for clients, and your photos never leave your Drive.

records.name: GlowPulse
records.tagline: Your Mac's camera is now a heart-rate sensor
records.description: GlowPulse measures your heart rate from your Mac's built-in camera using rPPG – no watch, no chest strap, no wearable. Lives in the menu bar with live BPM, sparkline, and color-coded zones. 100% on-device. Camera frames are processed in memory and discarded. No cloud, no account, no telemetry. Pomodoro focus with live HR chart. Breathing sessions with real-time HRV. 30-second stress check. $2.99 once. macOS 13+.

records.name: Sortail
records.tagline: Self-learning one-click inbox cleanup for Apple Mail
records.description: A tiny toolbar that floats above Apple Mail and sorts your inbox in one click — a single message, the whole thread, or every email from that sender, off to a folder, the archive, or the trash. It quietly learns where things usually go and starts suggesting the right folder for you.

records.name: Knock agent for Slack
records.tagline: Build, manage, and ship customer messaging from Slack
records.description: Knock is the agent-led customer engagement platform for managing all the messages your users receive across channels. After connecting Knock to Slack, simply tag @Knock in any channel, describe what you want, and let the agent work in the background to build campaigns, draft messaging, and update lifecycle workflows. The agent gathers the context from your account, posts progress updates in the thread as it works, and provides a link to the resource when it's ready to review.

records.name: RingDisk
records.tagline: Brighten your video calls with different toned ring lights
records.description: Say goodbye to dark, grainy webcams and unflattering shadows. RingDisk creates a beautiful, customizable glowing border around your screen that illuminates your face with a perfect studio glow. Whether you are on Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Skype, or recording self-tapes, RingDisk ensures you always look professional and well-lit. Designed specifically for macOS, RingDisk is lightweight, highly customizable, and extremely easy to use.

records.name: Paste MCP & AI Tools
records.tagline: Infinite clipboard for Claude, Codex and other AI tools
records.description: Privacy-first, lightning fast, searchable, and avaialbe across all devices. Save snippets, sync securely, and boost productivity with smart shortcuts and instant paste history.

records.name: Moxie Docs
records.tagline: Living docs + MCP context for your GitHub repos
records.description: Moxie Docs indexes your GitHub repo once, then puts that understanding where the work happens: repo context inside your AI agents over MCP, a searchable docs workspace, and PR checks that keep documentation honest.

records.name: Mirowl
records.tagline: Search all your screenshots via a local OCR-powered AI
records.description: A frictionless, local-first Mac app to index and search all your screenshots and image assets. Built with Rust/Tauri for zero footprint and powered by native macOS Vision for 10x OCR accuracy. Optional cloud, no tracking—just pure utility.

records.name: Gusto Cofounder
records.tagline: If Gusto, OpenClaw, and Claude Cowork had a baby...
records.description: Gusto Cofounder automates your entire small business. You describe your business processes and save them as Automations, which run on any schedule you want. Automations can connect to your systems outside of Gusto, such as Notion, Google Sheets, Quickbooks, or any MCP server you want. Like OpenClaw, you chat with Gusto Cofounder over SMS or Slack. Automations give you updates over SMS, and you can reply back. And of course, it comes with many Gusto capabilities across Payroll, Time and HR.

records.name: Fundraisly
records.tagline: AI fundraising agent that finds investors and books meetings
records.description: Fundraisly: ultimate AI agent for fundraising. It analyzes 300K+ investors and millions of deals, identifies the relevant ones actively investing in your space, maps warm paths to them from your own network, then covers the rest with targeted cold outreach. The result: 20-40 qualified investor meetings. Built by founders who raised over $1B.

records.name: Gigacatalyst
records.tagline: Give your Sales and CS teams engineering superpowers
records.description: Gigacatalyst.com's AI builder learns your APIs and embeds in your product, so your sales and CS teams can build missing features that customers need to your platform. When your software adapts to every customer's workflow, they utilize your software more, retain for longer, and expand quicker, because they get most custom implementation for their exact usecase.

records.name: Overline
records.tagline: Real-time AI captions and translation for any browser video
records.description: Overline is a Chrome extension that adds real-time AI captions and live translation on top of any browser video, no subtitles needed, no tab switching. Works on YouTube, Netflix, Twitch, Zoom, or any tab. Sub-second latency. Translation is optional and per-session. No page injection, no file uploads, pure live audio streaming.

records.name: Kompassify 2.0
records.tagline: User onboarding now with an AI copilot
records.description: We built Kompassify so teams could onboard users without touching code. 6 years later, it's grown into a full adoption platform shaped by your feedback: 🗺️ Product Tours ✅ Onboarding Checklists 🔔 Notifications Widget 📋 In-app Surveys 📊 Product Analytics 🤖 AI copilot to fix adoption 👋 Welcome Screens 🌍 Multi-language support ✂️ Segmentation One snippet. No-Coding required. Free plan no credit card required. 🚀

records.name: Co-Invest
records.tagline: Trade 500+ markets directly from ChatGPT & Claude
records.description: Co-Invest by Liquid lets you research and place real trades inside ChatGPT or Claude. Access 500+ markets across crypto, equities, FX, commodities, and prediction markets—24/7. Fund in-chat, use on-chain signals (wallet activity, positioning, funding, order flow), and execute in plain language with stops/targets. Your AI also handles support with full context.

records.name: Brief
records.tagline: Navigate your agents to product-market fit
records.description: AI agents can ship quickly, but without the right product context, they're often flying blind. Brief gives product teams a living source of truth that captures decisions, preserves product intent, and serves relevant context to humans and agents through chat, Slack, CLI, and MCP. It keeps strategy, decisions, and execution connected from vision to impact.

records.name: Branda
records.tagline: A fun new way to create & manage brands.
records.description: Branda turns a name and idea into a complete brand identity in minutes: strategy, logo, palette, type, and full brand kit. Start from scratch or import existing assets. ✨ 200 free credits on signup ✨ Let AI lead with Lucky, or guide strategy, sketches, and vector concepts yourself. Use visual prompts to keep every generation consistent, extract elements, vectorize to SVG, upscale, export, and share a public showcase.

records.name: Enshittifier
records.tagline: Chrome extension that replaces "AI" with 💩
records.description: The Mac app started as a dumb question: can you use font ligatures to turn AI into 💩? Turns out yes. Ironically, I used AI to figure out how. The Chrome extension came after — web fonts don't always cooperate. So mostly this is me poking fun. It's also a small nudge to be a little more mindful of the din around AI. Starting, apparently, with your font files.

records.name: PawPause
records.tagline: Lock your keyboard and prevent cats from causing chaos
records.description: A tiny macOS menu bar app that detects when your cat is on the keyboard and pauses input system-wide. 100% on-device. Open source. Free.

records.name: MartinLoop
records.tagline: Control AI coding agents with limits, proof, + run receipts
records.description: MartinLoop is the control plane for autonomous AI coding agents. Today, it wraps Claude, Codex, OpenCode, and other agents with spend limits, proof checks, safety rules, rollback, and run receipts. The bigger build turns that into a full agent control plane: dashboards, HeadlessOS-style execution, team oversight, cost visibility, and a trusted record of what every agent did, why it kept going, and why it stopped. Unbounded AI agents are expensive. Fix that. Run it. Prove it. Stop it

records.name: ConnectWizard
records.tagline: Unlock hidden App Store Connect analytics
records.description: App Store Connect only shows a fraction of the data Apple actually collects about your app. ConnectWizard unlocks all 100+ report types — both App Store data and on-device data from your users. Get started with pre-defined stats and pin the ones that matter to you, or dig into the raw data and build your own presets. If your app has a larger user base, you also get detailed framework usage data like how long Live Activities are used or which Shortcuts run or fail.

records.name: Rodeo by TwelveLabs
records.tagline: Describe your shot. Rodeo builds your first cut.
records.description: Rodeo by TwelveLabs is the AI video intelligence platform for creators and teams who produce at scale. Stop wasting hours scrubbing footage. Go from raw clips to a first cut in minutes using plain language. It's structured creation, not manual review. Unlike transcript-first tools, Rodeo's multimodal AI understands visuals, audio, speech, and text simultaneously, making it perfect for visual-first content. Your video library is now instantly queryable for humans and agents.

records.name: Vokal
records.tagline: A collaboration space for 10x teammates with their Al agents
records.description: Your Codex and my Codex can’t talk, so we play human telephone in Slack: copy prompts, paste summaries, ask for reviews, and lose the run. Vokal brings 10x teammates and their agents into one live workspace in minutes, whether they run local Codex, Claude Code, or Hermes — or in the cloud. Name your agents, give them roles, access, and memory, and work will happen in a shared collaboration space instead of through copy-paste handoffs.

records.name: choclift
records.tagline: Use iPhone to open apps, Apple Shortcuts and websites on Mac
records.description: Think beyond the keyboard, trackpad, and mouse: choclift is the third interface for interacting with your Mac. It turns your iPhone into a customizable chocolate bar that lets you instantly switch between favorite and recent Mac apps, trigger Apple Shortcuts without any detours, and use website bookmarks like never before. With a strong focus on product design and user experience, we're just getting started on building the quickest and sweetest way to work with your Mac.

records.name: NiobiStar
records.tagline: Next-Gen Secure GitHub Growth & Reputation Management Matrix
records.description: It is a next gen github growth & reputation management matrix

records.tagline: The task layer for your AI agents
records.description: Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible AI agent directly to Superlist. Create tasks, set due dates, manage lists, and automate recurring routines using plain-language prompts — no copy-paste required.

records.name: AWS Savings Calculator by Usage AI
records.tagline: See your savings in 60 seconds
records.description: Upload your AWS bill and see exactly how much you could save. Free, no account access, results in under 60 seconds. Three input methods: live calculator, invoice upload, or Cost Explorer CSV for up to 92% accuracy.

records.name: SelfMeditate
records.tagline: No guides. Just your practice.
records.description: Most meditation apps are audio libraries. You press play, follow a voice, and come back tomorrow to be guided again. We built SelfMeditate for people who want to sit with themselves. No guided meditations. No voices. Just a timer, interval bells, ambient sounds, a presence tracker, a private journal with voice notes and drawings, and insights into your own practice patterns. Everything stays on your device. No account. No ads. Own your practice.

records.name: ResumeToJobs
records.tagline: Free Job Search Tools
records.description: Free ATS resume checker tool. Upload your resume and get an instant ATS compatibility score with actionable optimization tips. Beat applicant tracking systems and land more interviews.

records.name: Text Reverse Tool
records.tagline: Flip letters, words, or lines in one click with this tool.
records.description: Use Ease Tools Text Reverse Tool to reverse any text instantly. Flip letters, words, or lines in one click with a fast and simple online tool.

records.name: BaziGrid
records.tagline: BaziGrid | Modern Bazi Analysis: Timing is not luck.
records.description: BaziGrid maps your behavioral architecture and macro-environmental cycles. Precision timing intelligence for professionals.

records.name: EARS
records.tagline: Map your musical DNA from 5 tracks that rewired you
records.description: Most music apps ask what you like. ears asks what changed you. Drop 5 songs that rewired you. Get back: → Your archetype (Sonic Archaeologist, Velvet Drifter, Harmonic Architect... → Your mode (Dorian, Lydian, Mixolydian...) → Your era + influence chain → 12-track Listening Room matched to your harmonic signature → Sonic Neighbors — listeners wired exactly like you Not collaborative filtering. Not "similar artists." Your actual ear.

records.name: invest2gether
records.tagline: The world's first Shariah-compliant trend-following AI depot
records.description: invest2gether is the first automated, Shariah-compliant trend-following depot simulator. While conventional retirement products shift assets into interest-bearing accounts (Riba) during market crashes, our smart algorithm automatically switches to physical gold. Built with integrated real-time Zakat estimation, dividend purification calculation, and automated Sadaqah Jariyah integration for sustainable global water, orphanage, and mosque building projects.

records.name: DeepZer
records.tagline: AI-powered Meta Ads campaign builder
records.description: DeepZer helps entrepreneurs, businesses, agencies and freelancers create, analyze and optimize Meta Ads campaigns with AI. It supports campaign structure, ad copy, segmentation, creatives and performance analysis for Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads and WhatsApp. No guaranteed results, just less manual work.

records.name: SproutBowl: AI Family Meal Tracker
records.tagline: Privacy-first, AI-powered meal tracker for the whole family.
records.description: Track your family’s nutrition in seconds. Snap a photo, and our on-device AI instantly categorizes meals into 9 essential groups. Perfect for toddler meals and allergy management. 100% private, no photos leave your device. Complete free & no limits.

records.name: Planamis
records.tagline: Plan better hangouts with friends using AI (or not)
records.description: Planamis keeps hangouts simple with shared spaces for plans, expenses, polls, notes, games, and chat with friends.

records.name: Pantry to Plate
records.tagline: Cook with what you already have, not a shopping list
records.description: Most recipe apps work backwards — find a recipe, then buy everything on the list. Pantry to Plate starts with what's in your kitchen. Add your ingredients and get meals you can make right now, plus close matches that need one or two more things. Sort by breakfast, lunch, dinner, or snack. Save favorites, follow along in cook mode, and skip the grocery run. Built for busy weeknights, tight budgets, and using things up before they go bad. No ads. No account. Free on iOS and Android.

records.name: VeriTrade AI
records.tagline: Cryptocurrency Bitcoin Automated Crypto Trading bot
records.description: VeriTrade AI is an automated crypto trading platform designed to remove emotional decision-making from trading. Built around structured execution, risk management, and verified trade logic, VeriTrade focuses on consistency rather than prediction. The system monitors market conditions, waits for predefined criteria, and executes only when conditions align.

records.name: Bellotify
records.tagline: The easiest way for brands to announce updates
records.description: Keep your users in the loop! Bellotify is a lightweight changelog platform built for indie hackers. Easily publish product updates, embed a customizable notification widget on your site with one line of code, and track visitor engagement. We believe in building in public! Check out our open roadmap and share your thoughts on GitHub: https://github.com/dylanduook/bellotify-feedback

records.name: AdaptingAlpha
records.tagline: The AI stock picker that learns from being wrong
records.description: AdaptingAlpha gives you 1–3 high-conviction stock picks a day, explains why, tracks whether each one worked, and adjusts its own factor weights from the outcomes. US stocks + Chinese A-shares, an AI advisor chat, a portfolio tracker, and a public Track Record so you can see the real hit rate.

records.name: BoltSchema
records.tagline: Turn any database into a hosted MCP server
records.description: Connecting LLMs and AI agents to real-time production data shouldn't mean writing endless boilerplate middleware. BoltSchema automatically converts your PostgreSQL into secure, production-ready, and hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. Save days of engineering time, handle JSON-RPC schemas automatically, and let your AI securely query the exact data context it needs in under 60 seconds.

records.name: MealEase AI
records.tagline: AI meal planning for busy households and families
records.description: MealEase is not another recipe app or chatbot. It connects the full dinner loop: what to cook tonight, what your household likes, what is already in the fridge, what needs to be bought, what leftovers can become, and what the week may cost. Standout features include household memory, Snap & Cook, Weekly Autopilot, smart grocery lists, Leftovers AI, Budget Intelligence, and MealEase Copilot.

records.name: InVariants (Beta)
records.tagline: Explore your data's shape with TDA, ML & AI — no code
records.description: InVariants is a no-code data platform that combines Topological Data Analysis, Machine Learning, and dimensionality reduction — and lets you export trained models as ready-to-run Python bundles. Run persistent homology, Mapper graphs, clustering, anomaly detection, time series analysis, and ML training. We're looking for beta testers. Try it free at invariants.tech.

records.name: Vintapp
records.tagline: Snap your clothing, AI lists it on Vinted in 1 click
records.description: Snap your clothing. Vintapp's AI writes the title, sets the right price (calibrated on 34K Vinted sales) and generates 4 pro mannequin photos. Then it auto-fills the Vinted listing — brand, size, color, material, category, everything. You tap Publish, listing online in 30 seconds. Indie iOS app, built solo from Toulouse, France.

records.name: Virality Predictor
records.tagline: Predict video virality before you publish.
records.description: Virality Predictor is an advanced AI video analysis tool that scientifically predicts your video's viral potential using neuromarketing principles. Upload your video to instantly receive insights on hook strength, attention span, memory encoding, and focus drift, allowing you to optimize your content before publishing. Secure audience attention, improve engagement, and maximize your ad spend by eliminating guesswork and ensuring your creative resonates with viewers from the very first second.

records.name: Shareable
records.tagline: Make everything your agent explains shareable.
records.description: Shareable turns the artifacts your agent produces into permanent URLs you can share. These shared artifacts are turned into an LLM-readable wiki to provide searchable context for Agents to utilize. One CLI makes both your teammates and your agents smarter.

records.name: DopaHop
records.tagline: The no-guilt task & focus app for ADHD brains
records.description: DopaHop is a task & focus app built by a solo dev with ADHD, for ADHD brains. Most productivity apps run on guilt and broken streaks — this one doesn't. Dump one overwhelming task and it splits into small, doable steps. Plus routines, meds reminders, brain dump, focus timer and sounds, mood check-ins and home-screen widgets: the whole ADHD day in one app, not ten. Miss a day? It just welcomes you back. Free on iOS & Android.

records.name: Karma: The Honesty Test
records.tagline: 100 moral dilemmas. One honest verdict on who you are.
records.description: Most personality tests ask you to describe yourself. Karma judges you by the choices you actually make. 100 moral dilemmas across 10 traits, two buttons, randomised positions so you can't game it. After 10 levels: one of 5 archetypes — Saint, Hero, Realist, Rebel, or Villain. Built solo in Godot. Free, no IAP, no accounts.

records.name: Humm - Share the Vibe
records.tagline: Quantify the vibe.
records.description: You went to a party, you loved the atmosphere, next day you want to share the moment on social media, describing the amazing experience, people might love the view but can't understand the "vibe" This is where my app comes in, simply put to quantify the vibe and give a shareable metric("party" score) based on all the ambient sounds around you, captured right in the moment. Similarly, if you want to share how good a place is for deep focus, you can share the "focus" score.

records.name: ShadowingEnglish
records.tagline: Turn any YouTube video into an interactive Shadowing lesson.
records.description: ShadowingEnglish.com is a smart tool designed for English learners who love the Shadowing technique. Simply paste any YouTube link, and our platform will instantly transform it into a powerful learning tool. Key Features: - Instant YouTube Integration: Practice with any content you actually enjoy—vlogs, movies, TED Talks, or news. - Smart Auto-Chunking: Our AI automatically cuts and divides the video into bite-sized, natural sentences. No more manual pausing!

records.name: From Me To You - Death Tech / App
records.tagline: Pass on memories to friends and family, after you're gone.
records.description: From Me To You automatically passes on private messages and media to friends and family after you're no longer around. Fill your wall with anything that you want, and assign it to those who matter most. Videos, photos, audio, stories, jokes, recipes - whatever best defines who you are.

records.name: Fabulix
records.tagline: Dutch reading tracker for iPhone. Track books, build streaks
records.description: Houd bij wat je leest met Fabulix. Volg je voortgang, bouw een leesstreak op en bereik je leesdoelen. Gratis te downloaden voor iPhone en iPad.

records.name: Cedrus
records.tagline: Track your crypto, stocks & real estate in USD / AED
records.description: The best crypto tracker in AED for UAE & GCC investors. Track Bitcoin, Ethereum & 1000+ coins alongside stocks, real estate & gold. AI wealth advisor. Free 30-day trial.

records.name: Drivestream

records.description: Drivestream Fleet GPS Drivestream is a mobile-based GPS solution designed for fleets to monitor real-time vehicle locations, access trip history, and enable mobile workers to log their hours—all without the need for expensive GPS equipment. Discover why Drivestream really is the GPS solution without the costs or hassles. No Cost Plan Uses existing mobile phone No additional tracking device No additional SIM card No installation Low data usage No contracts or upfront costs

records.name: PulseCalendar
records.tagline: The calendar that coaches you, not just lists your day
records.description: Most calendars are passive lists. PulseCalendar reads where your time actually goes (a live Pulse Score), parses plain text into events (“lunch with Marc tomorrow 1pm”), protects your focus blocks on autopilot, and turns public holidays into the longest weekends for the fewest days off. World Sync finds a meeting slot across every time zone in seconds. On-device by default, no account required, 9 languages.

records.name: Bodha Route Planner
records.tagline: Cut delivery costs with AI-powered route optimization
records.description: Bodha Route Planner helps delivery teams optimize routes in seconds, reduce fuel costs, track drivers in real time, and capture proof of delivery. Whether you're managing local deliveries, field operations, or multi-stop routes, Bodha replaces manual planning with AI-powered optimization so your team can deliver more stops in less time.

records.name: xopet — Track your pet's life
records.tagline: Track health records, reminders, documents and create AI art
records.description: XOPet is the all-in-one pet tracker for pet owners. Keep your pet's health records, reminders, documents, and milestones organized in one place. Turn pet photos into stunning AI artwork. Choose from multiple styles and create unique portraits. Never forget vaccinations, appointments, vet visits, or schedules. Set reminders and stay on top of pet care. Store important information, including weight, microchip number, medical history, and all health details in a secure place.

records.name: Momentum Todo
records.tagline: Build momentum with tasks, routines, streaks, and focus.
records.description: Momentum Todo is a productivity app built around a simple idea: small consistent actions create meaningful progress. Momentum Todo focuses on helping people stay organized and build momentum every day. Features include: • Fast task capture • Recurring routines • Daily streaks and streak protection • Heatmap calendar progress tracking • Persistent reminders • Multiple themes and languages It is designed for people who want clarity, consistency, and a sustainable way to stay productive.

records.name: Cosmo Translator
records.tagline: Talk to anyone naturally without the language barriers
records.description: Cosmo is a real-time voice translator for iOS and Android built for live, two-way conversations. Translate across 70+ languages with a live bilingual conversation log, voice selection, noise and speed control, and other configurations. Start free with 20 credits, no account required. Unlike general translation tools built for quick phrases and lookups, Cosmo empower real spoken conversations between two people in realistic scenarios across travel, business, relationships, and everyday life.

records.name: aaremarzili - Aare Temperature in Bern

Explore a map with every swimming spot, dangerous zones, boat rentals, and handpicked local partner restaurants. Everything you need for the best Aare experience, in one app. 🌊🏊‍♂️🚣‍♀️🍻

records.name: PlateLens
